title: John Graas, Shorty Rogers and other tuba dates
summary: He recalls playing tuba on Graas's album and lists sides with Wardell Gray, Dexter Gordon and Charlie Ventura.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Rite Spot, yeah. Well, we worked there for quite a while. Then I see John Graas, who passed away when
he was very young. I did an album with him, "Coup De Graas"...

Yeah, he played French horn, and I played tuba with him. I've forgotten the bass player, but we can come back to it later. Yeah, I played the tuba with him, and Shorty Rogers I did a lot of tuba things with, and also...the name escapes me for the moment; I'll came back to that, too.

And I see Wardell Gray, "Way Out Wardell," and with Dexter Gordon. Charlie Ventura, yes, "Stompin' At The Savoy." Then I see my name again on Sun label (or the Sunset label is what it really was), "These Foolish Things" and "Get Happy". That was with Sweets Edison, Willie Smith, Shadow Wilson on drums, on piano Arnold Ross.
Now you ask me a question.
